package.name: landmark_dataset_gen
package.description: Auto-labeled soccer-field landmark dataset generator for YOLO, driven by the Webots ground-truth pose. The robot is positioned MANUALLY in the Webots editor; this tool projects the known field landmarks (L/T/X line intersections and goalposts) into camera pixels and writes YOLO labels, with a live overlay for verification and a keypress to save image+label pairs.
